# Home N More

> Premium home decor, candle stands, artisanal products, and luxury fragrances store based in Pakistan.

## Primary Pages
- [Home Page](https://homenmore.com/): Primary storefront showcasing featured home decor and new arrivals.
- [Shop](https://homenmore.com/shop): Complete catalog of home accents, candle holders, and lifestyle products.
- [About Us](https://homenmore.com/aboutus): Information about Home N More's heritage, artisanal design philosophy, and store details.
- [Contact Us](https://homenmore.com/contact): Store location, contact details, and customer support channels.
